In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], '''an election''' was held in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Hedrett]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], for the position of [[Senior Counselor]] on the [[Hedrett Council]], the settlement's governing body. [[Karid Blakken]], the incumbent leader of the council, was the popular favorite to triumph in the vote, but the former criminal [[junior counselor]] [[Westa Impeveri]] stood against him and unexpectedly won the election. Blakken suspected that Impeveri had engaged in electoral fraud and demanded a re-count, but, following an investigation, the result of the election was upheld.
